This '''subsidiary''' of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer [[Core Galaxy Systems]] designed and produced the [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|''Dynamic''-class]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] around the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In a wave of corporate expansion, Core Galaxy Systems purchased the independent engineering company which operated a small manufacturing plant on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Transel]]. Little oversight but continued funding from Core Galaxy Systems allowed the subsidiary to continue producing a single ''Dynamic''-class starship at a time.
